summary: Solve and independently sort temporal modes with coherent arity and real precision refinement.

identity.relation: Finite generalized temporal eigenspectrum and corresponding polarizations
identity.direction: M,A,selectors,scales -> sorted frequencies and optional polarizations
identity.definition: lambda*A*X=M*X; omega=i*lambda. Apply positive diagonal physical and radix-two similarity transforms to both matrices. Initial double eig is followed, when component residual>1e-12, by actual 50-decimal mpmath inversion and eig in a private cloned context. Reject final global or active component residual>1e-10. Convert to complex128 and normalize vectors without overflowing their unscaled magnitudes. Sorting is stable and independent by real/imaginary frequency.
identity.model: Dense linear generalized eigenproblem, with backward-error controlled arithmetic refinement
identity.geometry: No additional geometry; matrix contract carries physical meaning
identity.coordinates: Returned columns use the original matrix state coordinates
identity.boundary: Nonfinite matrices/solutions, singular inertia or excessive residuals fail; repeated modes have arbitrary basis
assumptions: SciPy double arithmetic plus mpmath1.3.0 core for genuine precision fallback.
Accuracy is limited by conditioning and rounded input coefficients; high precision is not a universal forward-error proof.
The retained four/six output vpa order split is intentionally removed; post-eig symbolic conversion provided no additional precision.

inputs.name: M
inputs.units: row derivative units divided by column state units

inputs.name: vectors
inputs.constraints: Does not change the eigenvalue calculation path.

inputs.name: oldmethod
inputs.constraints: 1 generalized SciPy eig; 2 eig of solve(A,M); both use balanced coordinates and the same refinement checks.

inputs.name: scales
inputs.constraints: Both M and A transformed identically; radix-two balance follows. None uses balancing alone.

inputs.name: output_count
inputs.constraints: 0..6 returns (M,A,w1,w2,X1,X2) prefix; five now has a defined X1. None returns the documented mapping.

outputs.name: w1
outputs.description: Frequencies sorted by decreasing real part.
outputs.constraints: omega=i*lambda; stable ties; not mode tracking.

outputs.name: w2
outputs.description: Same modes sorted by decreasing imaginary part.

outputs.name: X1
outputs.units: mixed state units with max-absolute normalization
outputs.constraints: Only vectors=True (or positional return); arbitrary phase and degenerate basis.

outputs.name: X2
outputs.units: mixed state units with max-absolute normalization

outputs.name: residual1
outputs.description: Scaled global backward error for w1.
outputs.constraints: Finite and at most1e-10; not a forward-accuracy certificate.

outputs.name: residual2
outputs.description: Scaled global backward error for w2.

outputs.name: component_residual
outputs.constraints: 50-decimal fallback if double exceeds1e-12; reject if final exceeds1e-10.

outputs.name: precision
outputs.constraints: complex128 or mpmath-50-decimal-to-complex128; original input coefficients remain double precision.

preconditions: Finite nonempty same-shaped square M and A; A nonsingular; positive finite optional similarity scales.
oldmethod in {1,2}; vectors boolean; output_count None or integer0..6. Matrix units and physical meaning are caller responsibility.
supported: Dense generalized temporal eigenproblem with coherent values/vectors, stable independent real/imaginary sorts and backward-residual-controlled arithmetic.
excluded: No species initialization, unit conversion, physical sign/relativity validation, scan scheduling, plotting or mode tracking.
No universal forward eigenvalue accuracy, unique degenerate polarizations or recovery of precision lost in input coefficients.
Only local authorized D2 evaluation; redistribution rights remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid M/A shape, nonfinite matrix/scales, selectors or singular inertia where detected.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy/SciPy/mpmath failures propagate; ArithmeticError rejects nonfinite modes, zero vectors or excessive final residuals.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Underlying eigensolver failure propagates; no physical iteration or fabricated result.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No spectrum mapping or positional result returned after failure; no file or plotting side effects.

python.signature: solve_pdrf_spectrum(M, A, *, vectors=False, oldmethod=2, scales=None, output_count=None)

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import solve_pdrf_spectrum
r = solve_pdrf_spectrum(np.diag([-1j, 2j]), np.eye(2), vectors=True)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['w1'], [1, -2])

scope: Independent analytic cold/warm temporal limits and low-frequency SI modes using separately constructed matrices.
Corresponding vector residuals, numerical method/arity coherence, stable sorting, finite matrices and precision refinement on rounded inputs.
